title: ITC-1132-2025 - Circular - Addendum - Revised SOP for Virtual-Hybrid Hearing of cases in the High Court of Gujarat
text:

FEE PEGE COURT
Date: 25/09/2025

07/08/2025, as approved by Hon’ble the Chief Justice in view of the

FULL TEXT:
ee opt
FEE PEGE COURT
CF CASPAR AT
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
CIRCULAR
No. ITC/1132/2025
Date: 25/09/2025
ADDENDUM
REVISED STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE FOR VIRTUAL / HYBRID
HEARING OF CASES IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
AND
MODALITIES FOR ADMITTING THE PARTICIPANT FROM THE WAITING
ROOM OF THE VC APPLICATION
Read: 1. Circular No.ITC/917/2025 dated 07/08/2025
In continuation of the earlier Circular No. ITC/917/2025, dated
07/08/2025, as approved by Hon’ble the Chief Justice in view of the
decision taken by the Hon’ble Full Court of the High Court of Gujarat,
professional attire for the Advocates mentioned in the Para-7 of the revised
SOP for Hybrid Hearing of cases in the High Court of Gujarat vide above
referred Circular No. ITC/917/2025, dated 07/08/2025, is defined as below:
“The Advocate must be dressed in professional attire which
includes white shirt, black coat, band but does not include
gown.”
REGISTRAR GENERAL
